join.purpose.title: Become a member
join.purpose.intro: To collect stamps and points in {programme}, join with your Zalo phone number.
join.purpose.what: Your Zalo phone number, display name and Zalo user id, and your purchases at the shop.
join.purpose.why: To recognise you at the counter, credit stamps and points, and let you earn from a receipt.
join.purpose.howLong: While you are a member and at most {months} months after your last purchase, unless you leave earlier.
join.purpose.zaloAsks: Next, Zalo asks whether you allow sharing your phone number. You can refuse and keep using the app.
join.consent.title: Agree to join
join.consent.loyalty: I agree that {entity} processes my phone number and purchases for the membership programme (required to join).
join.consent.marketingHint: You can stop them at any time under Account.
join.problem.phone-expired: The phone confirmation has expired. Choose Join to try again.
join.problem.policy-outdated: The privacy policy has just changed. Read it again, then choose Join.
join.problem.phone-in-use: This phone number belongs to another Zalo account. Ask the staff at the counter.
join.problem.unknown-store: The store in the link is no longer used. Try again from Home.
join.problem.network: No connection. Check the network and try again.
join.problem.unknown: Joining did not work. Try again in a few minutes.

join.follow.title: Follow the Official Account
join.follow.body: Follow the shop's Official Account to know when stamps and points arrive.

wallet.notMemberTitle: You are not a member yet
wallet.notMemberBody: Join to collect stamps and points with every purchase.
code.title: Member code
code.intro: Show this code to the cashier before paying. It changes every minute.
code.pickFirst: Choose the store you are buying at to get a code.

claim.result.pending.body: Points arrive when the shop syncs its receipts, usually within a few minutes.
claim.result.matched.title: Points added
claim.result.matched.body: The receipt matches the shop's data.
claim.result.rejected.title: This receipt was not accepted
claim.reason.amount_mismatch: The total does not match the receipt.
settings.title: Account
settings.notMember: You are not a member. You can see the stores and the menu without sharing anything.
settings.marketingOff: You do not receive promotions. Messages about stamps and points still arrive.
settings.stopConfirmBody: The shop stops sending you promotions at once. Your stamps and points do not change.
settings.leaveBody: Ask to leave the programme so the shop deletes your member details. Unused stamps and points are lost.
settings.leaveConfirmBody: The shop handles the request and deletes your member details. Unused stamps and points are lost.
settings.leaveSent: Your request to leave was sent. The shop will handle it and tell you.
settings.language: The app follows Zalo's language setting.
programme.summary: Collect a stamp with every purchase at the counter. A full card of {count} stamps earns a reward at the store.
programme.reward: {count} stamps: a reward at the store.
programme.stampValidity: Stamps are valid for {months} months from the day you get them.
programme.pointsRule: Each receipt also earns points by its value.
join.purpose.howLongPolicy: While you are a member and for the period in the privacy policy, unless you leave earlier.
claim.result.queued.title: Receipt sent
claim.result.queued.body: Two receipts look the same, so the store checks them and credits the right one.
claim.result.expired.title: Waiting time over
claim.result.expired.body: The receipt was not found in time.
claim.reason.daily_cap: You have sent the most receipts allowed today.
